## Methods & tools

**Statistical modelling:** spatially varying coefficient models · Moran eigenvector spatial filtering · spatial autoregressive models · quantile regression · compositional data analysis · Bayesian hierarchical models · discrete choice models · spatio-temporal kriging · penalised regression (generalised / fused / network lasso)

**Programming & software:** R · Stan · Python · ArcGIS · QGIS

## Code & data

**MSVQR: Moran eigenvector-based spatially varying quantile regression.** R code and data for the simulation experiments and the rental-housing case study in Peng & Inoue (2026, *IJGIS*). CC BY 4.0.
[figshare](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.28366949){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
